verdict.rationale: Dover documents an API for adding candidates and listing hires, so a downloadable machine-readable API spec is a fair question here. However, the probe found every common OpenAPI or Swagger path returning 404, and no evidence shows a downloadable spec. The llms.txt file is a docs index, not an API specification, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
